scope: Evidence ledger only (STEP 1-2). No 3D build/render per scope change.

choice.reason: 4B-GF and 4B-FF are approx_calibrated (px/m 28.145 GF, 29.356 FF; residual <=1.8%) and the floorplan3d spike exists for 4B-GF; GF plan shows pool (labelled 9.50x2.40), rear terrace, outdoor terrace, courtyard water, driveway with 2 bays, 3 entrances, planting strips and 12 tree symbols; brochure p25 (front/driveway) and p26 (rear/pool/garden) are same-villa '4 BEDROOM VILLA' exterior renders. 5B has more labelled outdoor spaces (8 vs 5) and is also GF/FF calibrated, but 4B's pool calibration span, spike and default made it the stronger pick; 6B GF is NTS.

scale.ff_to_gf_registration: gx=196+(fx-146)*0.9588; gy=87+(fy-92)*0.9588 (pool left edge & top; checked with lift: GF ~8.92 m vs FF ~8.96 m from pool top)
scale.rf_registration: NTS, rf->ff approx (x+80,y+90), checked with lift

status_legend.observed: drawn/labelled in plan or shown in same-villa render
